description:
Open-source developer workspace for code snippets, notes, HTTP requests, and developer tools

massCode is an open-source desktop workspace for developers. It brings together code snippets, technical notes, a full-featured HTTP client, and a collection of developer tools. Snippets, notes, and requests are stored as Markdown files on disk.
OpenRouter Provider
The AI assistant now supports OpenRouter. Enter your OpenRouter API key to use models from many vendors through a single account, with requests billed to your OpenRouter balance. The model list includes only models with tool calling support, and model IDs use the vendor/model format, for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5.
See the AI Assistant guide for setup.

Workflow Improvements
- The AI assistant shows a clear message when a provider rejects your API key, and running out of credits on OpenRouter is reported as a quota error.
- The AI assistant can handle larger multi-step requests in a single response.
- Updated French translations.

Fixes
- Fixed pasting, dropping, and inserting images in Notes when using the default vault.
- Fixed several other actions that failed on the default vault, including AI folder icon changes and their undo, undo for AI task cleanup, and exporting rendered artifacts.
- Fixed AI HTTP actions resetting your current HTTP session, HTTP request previews ignoring session variables, and saved execution results not appearing in HTTP.
- Fixed the Raycast and VS Code extensions being unable to read snippets when API integrations are enabled.
- Fixed the AI assistant returning empty or partial results when listing workspace items with some models, such as OpenAI models through OpenRouter.
- Kept the settings button and app version visible in the sidebar in short windows.
